name: std::poisson_distribution<IntType>::mean
intro: Returns the μ parameter the distribution was constructed with. The parameter defines mean number of occurrences of the event. The default value is 1.0.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Floating point value identifying the μ distribution parameter.
